style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a brushed steel surface, extreme asymmetry, the hero off-centre and low in frame. The assembly features three recognizable engineered parts: a heavy data processing module, an unlatched inspection gate, and a severed brass linkage connector. Despite the physical disconnection, the isolated module displays a glowing green indicator light. Hard clean edges, one directional key light throwing a long cast shadow across the weathered surface. Matte muted palette, generous negative space. No text, no molded lettering.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, UI, watermarks, text, numbers, abstract blobs, plain geometry
rationale: The story exposes a structural discrepancy between a system's internal record and its actual state. A minimalist component assembly captures this systemic illusion by showing a severed physical connection that still registers as successful.
cue: A trace is a claim about state
subject: a modular mechanical assembly with a severed connector displaying a green indicator
core_thesis: A clean trace is merely a claim about state, not a photograph of it, meaning models often trust an internal log of success even when the actual step failed quietly.
core_conflict: The system's internal success log versus the actual physical state of the environment.
composition: extreme asymmetry, the hero off-centre and low in frame
alt_text: Why AI Agents Trust Bad Logs. A modular mechanical assembly with a severed connector displaying a green indicator light.
caption: Why AI Agents Trust Bad Logs: Models trust flawed records over actual state.
title: Why AI Agents Trust Bad Logs
